title: Power equivariance of the published shifted finite root chart
statement: Fix a finite purity setting P [def-pur-conventions], its algebraically closed base field k, coefficient ring A and exponent N = ell^n. For every k-scheme T, natural numbers d,a, and primitive N-th roots zeta, eta in k with zeta = eta^a, let c_zeta(d) and c_eta(d) be the published pro-etale shifted root-power charts of [def-pur-finite-reduction-root-charts]. Then c_eta(d).hom = a^d times c_zeta(d).hom, where multiplication is repeated addition in the derived module-sheaf category. No finite-type, connectedness or boundedness hypothesis is imposed; d = 0 and empty schemes are included.

source.place: Step 2, compatibility with the invertible twist by associativity of derived tensor; expanded root-chart normalization in def-pur-finite-root-tensor-presentation.

proof.text: On constant coefficient generators, the root trivialization for zeta = eta^a is a times the root trivialization for eta, by its specified section formula and the primitive-root basis. Composing with the inverse isomorphisms shows that the inverse chart for eta is a times the inverse chart for zeta. Single-complex realization and the degree-two shift preserve the equation.

Induct on the ordered tensor recursion defining the published shifted chart. At zero the root-independent unit chart has scalar a^0=1. At a successor, bilinearity changes a^d to a^d*a=a^(d+1); reassociation, unit and shift factors are fixed. Exact comparison inverse image is additive, and its fixed shift comparison preserves the equation. This proves the stated equality on every T, also empty T.

proof_origin.source: Explicit calculation of the prescribed root-chart power law from the existing section and ordered-basis normalizations.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteReductionPowerTrivialization_pow (P : PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [T.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] (d a : ℕ)
    (ζ η : P.field.k) (hζ : IsPrimitiveRoot ζ P.diagonalExponent)
    (hη : IsPrimitiveRoot η P.diagonalExponent) (h : ζ = η ^ a) :
    (P.finiteReductionPowerTrivialization T η hη d).hom =
      a ^ d • (P.finiteReductionPowerTrivialization T ζ hζ d).hom
